_what: THE 2026 NFL SEASON'S PHASE WINDOWS, as retrieved -- the evidence bettor_nfl_settlement.SEASON_WINDOWS rests on. Verbatim wikitext of the lead section (infobox and first paragraph); nothing interpreted here.
lead_sentences: The '''2026 NFL season''' is the 107th season of the [[National Football League]] (NFL).

The regular season began on September 9, 2026, with reigning [[Super Bowl LX|Super Bowl]] champion [[2026 Seattle Seahawks season|Seattle]] defeating [[2026 New England Patriots season|New England]] in the [[NFL Kickoff Game]], and will end on January 10, 2027.
The playoffs will begin on January 16 and conclude with [[Super Bowl LXI]] at [[SoFi Stadium]] in [[Inglewood, California]], on February 14.
